name: Ezekiel of Ilaadbat
source:
Ezekiel of Ilaadbat is a member of the Class of Exemplary Acolytes. He specializes in Neuromancy, and is considered the strongest student in the class of those who regularly attend.

He is Ysaran, and looks down on members of the other parties. He is not well-liked.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Ezekiel_of_Ilaadbat]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
